subject: english
question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

The children did not like the __abominable__ table manners of old aunt.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Obnoxious**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abominable **means very unpleasant or bad. (बहुत अप्रिय या बुरा)

 
 
• **Example**: *The abominable conditions in the neglected building shocked the community.*
 
 
 
• **Obnoxious **means extremely unpleasant or offensive. (अत्यंत अप्रिय या आपत्तिजनक)
 
 
• **Example**: *His obnoxious behaviour during the meeting offended everyone in the room.*
 
 
 
• Both words convey a negative connotation and are used to describe something that is disliked or unpleasant.
 
• In this sentence, "abominable" is used to describe the table manners of the old aunt, which the children did not like.
 
• Therefore, "obnoxious" is the most appropriate synonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delectable **means delicious or appetizing. (स्वादिष्ट)
 
• **Stringent **means strict or severe. (सख्त या गंभीर)
 
• **Inflexible **means unwilling to change or compromise. (बदलने या समझौता करने को तैयार नहीं)
